## What happened

This notice records incident INC-0251, titled “Consultant vacancy”. The incident was active from 2025-07-01 to 2026-02-28. The notice provides a concise record of the issue, its cause, and the effect on clinic provision during this period.

The incident relates to a consultant vacancy and is recorded for service awareness and follow-up. Staff referring to this matter should quote INC-0251 when contacting the service desk, so that enquiries can be directed to the appropriate record.

## Cause

The recorded cause was Retirement not backfilled. This meant that the consultant vacancy remained unresolved for the duration recorded in this notice.

## Effect

The recorded effect was Fast-track clinic slots cut. This describes the impact on the availability of fast-track clinic appointments associated with the incident. The notice closes the recorded period on 2026-02-28. Further questions about the incident should be directed to the service desk, quoting INC-0251.
